title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Gallery Rail Solid Brass Wall Mount | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double, Oil Rubbed Bronze
description:
Get countertop-clearing storage right where you need it with a wall-mounted double glass shelf designed for everyday bathroom essentials in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Coordinates with other Waverly Place pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Enjoy a refined, coordinated look with the Waverly Place collection for transitional bath accessories
- Install with a clean finish using concealed screw mounting hardware and included installation hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 in L x 8 in H x 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Materials: solid brass hardware with tempered glass shelves
- Mounting: wall mount (concealed screw mount)
- Assembly: not required
- Includes: glass shelf set and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
multiple designer finish options available for matching Waverly Place and versatile bath accessories
